desc.en: c ≡ a·p + b (mod 26). Caesar is just a = 1: b slides the alphabet, a stretches it. Set a to 13 and watch the map collapse — 24 letters become unreachable and two dozen plaintexts land on the same ciphertext, so decryption is not hard but impossible. That is what gcd(a,26)=1 is protecting. And the 312 keys buy nothing: on a short message chi-square picks the wrong one and the true key falls to eighth place.
desc.zh: c ≡ a·p + b (mod 26)。凯撒不过是 a = 1 的特例：b 让字母表滑动，a 让它拉伸。把 a 调到 13，映射当场塌缩——24 个字母再也到不了，二十几个明文挤到同一个密文上，于是解密不是困难而是**不可能**。gcd(a,26)=1 守的就是这件事。而 312 把钥匙什么也没买到：短报文上 χ² 会选错，真钥匙掉到第 8 名。

tag.en: stretch and slide · gcd(a,26)=1 · collapse · 312 keys
tag.zh: 拉伸与滑动 · gcd(a,26)=1 · 塌缩 · 312 把钥匙

desc.en: Three views of one shift. The wheel shows the cipher is literally a rotation — k=0 and k=26 are the same wheel. Lift 0…25 into a helix and "wrapping around" becomes one visible turn, which is all that mod 26 ever meant. Then lay out all 26 shifts at once and score each against English letter frequency: the winning row lights up on its own. The weakness was never the algorithm; it is that the key space has 26 elements and you can read all of them at a glance.
desc.zh: 同一个位移的三种看法。字母轮告诉你这个密码就是一次旋转——k=0 与 k=26 是同一个轮子。把 0…25 抬成一条螺旋，「绕回去」就成了肉眼可见的一整圈，而模 26 从头到尾就只是这个意思。最后把 26 个位移一次全摊开，各自与英文字母频率打分，正确的那一行自己亮起来。弱点从来不是算法，是密钥空间只有 26 个元素、一眼就能扫完。

tag.en: alphabet wheel · modulo 26 · brute force · chi-square
tag.zh: 字母轮 · 模 26 · 穷举 · 卡方

title.zh: 编码、摩尔斯与分割摩尔斯

desc.en: A code is not a cipher. Morse is public and keyless: encode a message and anyone can read it — put a Caesar beside it and both look unreadable, but only one is secret. Morse is also not prefix-free, which is why the separator is load-bearing: strip the gaps from ATTACK and it has 2456 valid readings; put them back and it has exactly one. Then use it as a substrate — variable-length re-expression destroys letter boundaries, and the frequency attack that passes straight through a substitution keeps only 27% of its signal.
desc.zh: 编码不是密码。摩尔斯是公开的、无密钥的：编好一条消息，谁都读得出——旁边摆一个凯撒，两者看上去同样不可读，但只有一个是秘密。摩尔斯**也不是前缀码**，这正是分隔符不可或缺的原因：把 ATTACK 的间隔去掉，它有 **2456 种**合法读法；间隔放回去，恰好一种。再把它当作基底——变长重表达摧毁了字母边界，那个能原样穿过代换密码的频率攻击，在这里只剩 27% 的信号。

tag.en: a code hides nothing · not prefix-free · 2456 readings · fractionated
tag.zh: 编码不隐藏任何东西 · 非前缀码 · 2456 种读法 · 分割摩尔斯

title.zh: 分割密码 —— Bifid 与 Trifid

desc.en: Split each letter into coordinates, then read them off in a different order. Period 1 is the proof that the period is the whole point: it collapses to the identity — the ciphertext is the plaintext, character for character. As the period grows, a letter still touches only two ciphertext letters (it has only two coordinates) but they drift apart, and the entanglement follows a sawtooth: odd periods bind the whole block, even periods always collapse back to two. That is why the period is conventionally odd.
desc.zh: 把每个字母拆成坐标，再按另一种顺序读回来。周期 1 就是「周期才是全部」的证据：它塌成恒等映射——密文逐字符等于明文。周期变大时，一个字母**依然**只碰到两个密文字母（它只有两个坐标），但两者越离越远；而纠缠分量走的是一条锯齿：奇数周期把整块绑成一体，偶数周期永远塌回 2。这就是周期按惯例取奇数的原因。

tag.en: bifid · trifid · period 1 is the identity · the odd/even sawtooth
tag.zh: Bifid · Trifid · 周期 1 即恒等 · 奇偶锯齿

desc.en: Encryption as a linear map. Affine was the 1×1 case; this is the same idea with more dimensions, and the inverse key is a matrix inverse mod 26. Plot all 676 digraphs as a lattice and a usable key merely shears it — but let the determinant share a factor with 26 and the lattice folds onto a sublattice, 624 cells becoming unreachable. Strong against frequency analysis, and it falls instantly to known plaintext: a linear map is determined by what it does to a basis.
desc.zh: 把加密当成一个线性映射。仿射是 1×1 的情形，这里是同一个想法多了几个维度，而逆密钥就是模 26 的矩阵逆。把 676 个双字母铺成一张点阵，可用的密钥只是把它**剪切**一下；可一旦行列式与 26 有公因子，点阵就折到一个子格上——624 个格子再也到不了。它对频率分析很硬，却在已知明文面前**当场崩塌**：线性映射由它在一组基上的作用完全决定。

tag.en: linear map mod 26 · matrix inverse · the lattice folds · known-plaintext
tag.zh: 模 26 线性映射 · 矩阵逆 · 点阵折叠 · 已知明文

desc.en: The first cipher here that is not modular arithmetic at all — the rule is positional: same row, same column, or the rectangle's other two corners. Encrypting pairs turns 26 symbols into 600 digraphs and flattens the single-letter profile that broke everything before it. Measured, though: flatter, not flat — about twice as flat as a substitution and still four times the theoretical floor. And the fingerprint did not vanish, it moved up a level. Count digraphs and it is back, identically.
desc.zh: 本章第一个完全不是模运算的密码——规则是**位置**的：同行、同列，或者矩形的另外两角。成对加密把 26 个符号变成 600 个双字母，把此前击穿一切的单字母分布压平了。但实测是「更平，不是平」：大约比单表代换平一倍，仍是理论地板的四倍。而且那枚指纹没有消失，只是上移了一层——改数双字母，它一模一样地回来了。

tag.en: positional rules · pairs not letters · flatter not flat · the fingerprint moved up
tag.zh: 位置规则 · 成对而非逐字 · 更平但不平 · 指纹上移了一层

desc.en: Every letter becomes two symbols, and the alphabet shrinks from 26 to 5. That alone buys nothing. The advance is what comes next: transpose the halves, and a letter's row-digit and column-digit end up far apart — measured here at up to 38 symbols. Substitution alone preserves the frequency fingerprint and so does transposition, but split each letter in two and then scatter the halves, and neither half is a letter any more. That is fractionation, and it is why ADFGX held.
desc.zh: 每个字母变成两个符号，字母表从 26 个缩到 5 个。光这一步什么也没买到。真正的进展是下一步：把两半打散，一个字母的行号与列号会落到很远的地方——这一页实测最远隔 38 个符号。单纯代换保住了频率指纹，单纯换位也保住了，可一旦把每个字母劈成两半再把两半冲散，**两半都不再是字母**。这就是分割，也是 ADFGX 撑住的原因。

tag.zh: 5×5 与 6×6 · 坐标 · 分割 · ADFGX

desc.en: Vigenère with keyed alphabets — and the attack only half survives. Measured here: on every multiple of the true period the index of coincidence is bit-identical to plain Vigenère, zero difference across 3472 values, because those cosets hold the same letters and both ciphers act on them bijectively. So the period still falls out. What dies is the last step: the blind shift attack drops from 98% to 6.6%, because each coset is now a substitution rather than a Caesar. Keying the alphabet defends the end of the attack, not the beginning.
desc.zh: 带密钥字母表的维吉尼亚——而攻击只有一半失效。这里实测：在真周期的每一个倍数上，重合指数与普通维吉尼亚**逐位相同**，3472 个值零差异，因为那些余类装着同一批字母，两种密码对它们的作用都是双射。所以周期照样掉出来。死掉的是最后一步：盲位移攻击从 98% 跌到 6.6%，因为每个余类现在是一次代换而不是一次凯撒。给字母表加密钥，守住的是攻击的末端，不是开端。

tag.en: keyed alphabets · period survives · the last step dies
tag.zh: 带密钥字母表 · 周期照样掉出来 · 最后一步失效

title.en: Solitaire — a Cipher in a Deck

desc.en: Schneier's hand cipher: 54 cards are the key state, and four shuffling operations generate the keystream. Move one card to the bottom and every one of 53 positions changes the stream immediately — but swap two adjacent cards and 16 of 53 change nothing at all, because the triple cut and count cut move whole blocks in order. The tool measures both, because the flattering perturbation is the misleading one. It is a stream cipher with no electronics: internal state, a step function, an output function — exactly the shape Chapter 4 runs at speed.
desc.zh: Schneier 的手工密码：54 张牌就是密钥状态，四步洗牌生成密钥流。把一张牌移到底部，53 个位置无一例外立刻改变密钥流——可要是把相邻两张对调，53 次里有 16 次**毫无变化**，因为三重切与计数切搬的是整块且保序。这一页把两种扰动都量出来，因为好看的那个恰恰是骗人的那个。它是一台不用电的流密码：内部状态、步进函数、输出函数——正是第 4 章高速运转的那个形状。

tag.en: 54 cards are the key · move vs swap, measured · a stream cipher by hand
tag.zh: 54 张牌即密钥 · 移动与对调的实测差别 · 手工流密码

desc.en: Vigenère fell because the key repeated. These never repeat — the key is the plaintext itself, or another book — and the period attack goes completely flat: measured, the IoC curve moves 0.005 across all candidate periods versus Vigenère's 0.034, staying inside the random band. And they still fall, because the key is English. Guess seven letters correctly in an autokey and the guess propagates until it has recovered the entire message. Removing the period does not remove the redundancy — closing that gap is what a one-time pad is for.
desc.zh: 维吉尼亚倒下是因为密钥重复。这两个从不重复——密钥就是明文本身，或者另一本书——于是周期攻击彻底变平：实测 IoC 曲线在全部候选周期上只摆动 0.005，而维吉尼亚是 0.034，整条都待在随机带里。可它们照样倒，因为密钥是**英语**。在自动密钥上猜对七个字母，这个猜测会自我传播，直到把整条报文还原出来。去掉周期并没有去掉冗余——补上这个缺口，正是一次一密要做的事。

tag.en: no period at all · and still breakable · the gap a one-time pad closes
tag.zh: 根本没有周期 · 却照样可破 · 一次一密要补的缺口

desc.en: Caesar has 26 keys. This has 26! — about 4×10²⁶, more than a machine running since the Big Bang could finish. It still falls to a pencil. Put the two frequency profiles side by side and sort them: the shapes are identical, only the labels moved. Substitution hides which letter, never how often, and that surviving fingerprint is the whole attack. Key space is not strength.
desc.zh: 凯撒有 26 把钥匙，这里有 26! 把——约 4×10²⁶，一台从大爆炸跑到现在的机器刚好数完。它照样败给一支铅笔。把明文与密文的频率分布并排排序，两条阶梯**形状完全一样**，只有标签换了位置。代换藏得住「是哪个字母」，藏不住「出现多少次」，而那个活下来的指纹就是全部攻击。密钥空间不等于强度。

tag.en: 26! keys · frequency fingerprint · key space is not strength
tag.zh: 26! 把钥匙 · 频率指纹 · 密钥空间不等于强度

desc.en: Write across, read down; or ride a zigzag over the rails. Nothing is replaced — the letters are the same letters in a new order. So the frequency profile is not merely similar to the plaintext's, it is identical, every bar to zero difference, while a Caesar shift beside it visibly displaces. That single fact splits classical cryptography in two: substitution changes which letters, transposition changes where, and the tool that breaks every substitution tells you nothing here.
desc.zh: 横着写、竖着读；或者沿着栅栏走一趟锯齿。没有任何字母被替换——密文就是同一批字母换了个顺序。于是频率分布不只是「接近」明文，而是**逐条为零地相同**，旁边同时画着的凯撒位移却明显错位。这一件事把古典密码劈成两半：代换换的是「哪个字母」，换位换的是「在哪里」，而那件能破掉所有代换密码的工具，在这里什么也告诉不了你。

tag.en: columnar · rail fence · identical frequencies · which vs where
tag.zh: 列换位 · 栅栏 · 频率完全相同 · 换什么与换到哪

changelog.en: Internal: picks up engine crypto-1.2.0 and a shared fix for the narrow-screen header. The tab bar sat 8px under the title below 760px — inherited by every tool from the skeleton, invisible on desktop. The engine also gains fitCells(), which derives how many cells fit from the space instead of flooring the cell size and letting content run off the canvas — the shape behind five separate overflow bugs.

desc.en: Not one cipher — n Caesars interleaved, which is why frequency analysis drowns: you are averaging n different alphabets. Find the period and the whole thing falls apart into n independent Caesars, each dying to the chi-square you already have. Two witnesses disagree about that period, and the page shows both: Kasiski counts repeated sequences, index of coincidence measures flatness, and on short text they contradict each other. Beaufort and Porta ride along as reciprocal variants.
desc.zh: 它不是一个密码，是 n 个凯撒交错在一起——频率分析淹死在这里，因为你平均的是 n 张不同的字母表。找到周期，整件事就散成 n 个独立的凯撒，每一个都死在你已经有的 χ² 手里。而周期这件事有两个证人、它们会吵架：Kasiski 数重复片段，重合指数量分布的平坦程度，短文本上两者会给出矛盾的答案——这一页把两条曲线都画出来。Beaufort 与 Porta 作为自逆变体同行。

tag.en: n Caesars interleaved · Kasiski vs IoC · period then collapse
tag.zh: n 个凯撒交错 · Kasiski 与 IoC · 定周期即崩解

title.zh: 密码机 —— 轮盘与销凸耳

desc.en: Jefferson's spindle of lettered discs and Hagelin's six pin wheels, both from before Enigma. Line the plaintext up along one row of 25 discs and every other row is a valid ciphertext — one setting, twenty-five choices. Hagelin buys its key length from arithmetic instead: six wheels of pairwise coprime periods, 17·19·21·23·25·26, so the keystream runs 101,405,850 characters before it repeats. Mechanism is what buys the period; the mechanism itself was never secret.
desc.zh: 杰斐逊的字母圆盘主轴，与哈格林的六个销轮，都早于恩尼格玛。把明文沿 25 个圆盘的某一行对齐，**其余每一行都是合法密文**——一个设置，二十五种选择。哈格林换了个办法买密钥长度：六个两两互素的周期，17·19·21·23·25·26，密钥流跑满 101,405,850 个字符才重复。买来周期的是机械结构，而结构本身从来不是秘密。

tag.en: M-94 spindle · pin-and-lug · 101,405,850 · the key is a configuration
tag.zh: M-94 主轴 · 销与凸耳 · 101,405,850 · 密钥是一份配置

desc.en: Follow one keypress all the way through: plugboard, three rotors, the reflector, back out through the rotors and the plugboard again. The reflector is what makes the machine self-inverse — and it is also the flaw, because a letter can therefore never encrypt to itself. Drag a crib along a real 1941 intercept and watch positions being struck out the instant any letter matches itself: a 52-letter crib kills 88.6% of them, matching 1−(25/26)^L to under a point. It was not the key space that fell; it was a structural property leaking at every position.
desc.zh: 跟着一次按键走完全程：插线板、三个转子、反射器，再从转子和插线板原路出来。反射器让整台机器自逆——**而它同时就是那个破绽**，因为任何字母都不可能加密成它自己。把 crib 沿一份 1941 年的真实截获电报拖过去，只要有一个字母与自己相同，那个位置当场被划掉：52 个字母的 crib 划掉 88.6%，与 1−(25/26)^L 的理论值相差不到一个百分点。倒下的不是密钥空间，是一个在每个位置都在漏信息的结构性质。

tag.en: rotors · double-stepping · no letter maps to itself · crib elimination
tag.zh: 转子 · 双步进 · 字母不会映到自己 · crib 排除

desc.en: Every earlier tool hands you the cipher and then shows you its weapon. Here you get ciphertext and nothing else. Four numbers computed from it alone name the family: a transposition keeps English letter counts exactly (chi-square identical to the plaintext's, to the last digit), a monoalphabetic substitution keeps the IoC exactly (0.0725 on both sides here) while chi-square jumps to 2079, and Playfair is caught by a property no statistic can fake — it cannot emit a doubled digraph at all, verified over 3600 pairs across six keys with row/column/rectangle each exercised. That structural test runs first, because Playfair's IoC (0.0504) sits in the same band as Vigenere's (0.0481) and no amount of IoC will separate them. Then the honest half: below 200 letters the page refuses to name a family, and shows you the sweep that earned that number — the two IoC ranges overlap through 100 letters and come apart at 150. The threshold never moved. The evidence did.
desc.zh: 前面每个工具都先告诉你这是什么密码，再教你它的武器。这一页只给你密文。四个只用密文就能算出来的数字就能叫出家族的名字：换位密码逐位保持英文的字母计数（χ² 与明文一模一样，一位不差），单表代换逐位保持重合指数（本页两侧都是 0.0725）而 χ² 跳到 2079，Playfair 则栽在一条统计量伪造不出来的性质上——它根本不可能吐出一对相同的字母，6 把密钥 × 3600 对穷举过，行/列/矩形三条规则各自都走到了。这条结构判据排在最前，因为 Playfair 的 IoC（0.0504）与维吉尼亚（0.0481）落在同一档，靠 IoC 永远分不开它们。然后是诚实的那一半：不足 200 个字母时，这一页拒绝给出家族，并把挣来这个数字的那张扫描图摆给你看——两条 IoC 区间在 100 字母处仍然重叠，到 150 才分开。阈值一步没动，动的是证据。

tag.en: IoC · chi-square · doubled digraphs · the discriminant tree · when the sample is too small
tag.zh: 重合指数 · χ² · 重复二元组 · 判别树 · 样本不足时

desc.en: Four steps run in a loop, and each one has exactly one job. The way to see that is to switch one off. Turn off ShiftRows and AES stops being a block cipher at all — it becomes four independent 32-bit ciphers, because MixColumns only ever mixes within a column, so no byte can reach another column. Measured over every bit of column 0 across ten rounds: 0 of 320 observations touch another column with ShiftRows off, 312 of 320 with it on, and the 8 that still don't are precisely the row-0 byte that ShiftRows leaves in place. Diffusion is not any single step — it is two steps that look redundant apart. The other switches are just as blunt: without ShiftRows the avalanche saturates at 12.5% (one column), without MixColumns at 3% (one byte), and without SubBytes the whole cipher goes affine and E(a)+E(b)+E(c)+E(a+b+c) collapses to zero in 500 of 500 trials. Intact, it reaches full diffusion at round 2 and every one of the 128 input bits moves all 16 bytes.
desc.zh: 四个步骤在一个循环里跑，每一个只干一件事。要看清这点，最好的办法是把某一个关掉。关掉 ShiftRows，AES 当场就不再是分组密码——它变成四个互不相干的 32 位密码，因为 MixColumns 只在列内搅拌，没有任何字节能走到别的列去。实测：翻遍列 0 的每一个比特、走十个轮次，关掉时 320 次观察里有 0 次影响到别的列，开着时是 312 次，而剩下那 8 次恰好就是 ShiftRows 原地不动的那个第 0 行字节。扩散不属于任何单独一步——它是两个单看都像多余的步骤合作出来的。其它开关同样干脆：没有 ShiftRows，雪崩停在 12.5%（一列）；没有 MixColumns，停在 3%（一个字节）；没有 SubBytes，整个密码变成仿射的，E(a)⊕E(b)⊕E(c)⊕E(a⊕b⊕c) 在 500 次里 500 次归零。四步齐全时，第 2 轮就达到完全扩散，128 个输入比特每一个都能撼动全部 16 个字节。

tag.en: state matrix · switch a step off · ShiftRows is the diffusion · avalanche by round
tag.zh: 状态矩阵 · 关掉某一步 · 扩散靠 ShiftRows · 逐轮雪崩

desc.en: Two people agree on a secret while everyone listens, and the secret is never sent. Both sides raise the same public g to their own private exponent, exchange the results, and raise again — arriving at the same number by different routes. The whole thing rests on one asymmetry you can count: at p = 101, computing g^a forward takes 5 operations, while walking it back takes up to 100 tries, and the plot of g^x mod p has no slope to follow and no ordering to exploit. Brute force is all an eavesdropper has, which is exactly why real p is 2048 bits — the largest prime-field discrete log ever published is 795 bits. The tool also shows the trap: pick g badly and the key space collapses without a single other number on screen changing. At p = 101, g = 2 reaches all 100 values; g = 10 reaches four.
desc.zh: 两个人在所有人的注视下商定一个秘密，而这个秘密从未被发送过。双方把同一个公开的 g 抬到各自的私有指数上，交换结果，再抬一次——从两条不同的路走到同一个数。全部依据是一条你可以数出来的不对称：p = 101 时，正向算 g^a 只要 5 次运算，反推回去最多要试 100 次，而 g^x mod p 的图像既没有可循的斜率，也没有可利用的次序。窃听者手里只有穷举，这正是真实的 p 要取 2048 位的原因——迄今公开的素域离散对数最大纪录是 795 位。这一页还摆出那个陷阱：g 选得不好，密钥空间会当场塌陷，而屏幕上其它任何数字都不会变。p = 101 时 g = 2 能走遍全部 100 个值，g = 10 只能走到 4 个。

tag.en: colour mixing · modular exponentiation · discrete log · the generator trap · MITM
tag.zh: 颜色混合 · 模幂 · 离散对数 · 生成元陷阱 · 中间人

desc.en: The private key is never stored anywhere — it is derived, and it exists only because e happens to be invertible modulo phi(n). Watch the chain compute itself: p and q pick n, n and its factors give phi(n), e must be coprime to phi(n), and d falls out as the modular inverse. Break any link and the page shows you the break rather than a crash: choose e = 3 against phi = 60 and gcd is 3, so d does not exist and the row goes magenta. Then the epiphany — everything above rests on one thing, that factoring n is hard. At 16 digits your browser factors it in about 100 milliseconds at 213 million trials per second, recovers d bit-identical to the true one, and reads the message. The cost climbs by ten for every two digits; the only difference at 2048 bits is the size of the number. Exhaustively verified: every message in [0, n) round-trips for five keys, 22981 in total.
desc.zh: 私钥并不存放在任何地方——它是**推导**出来的，而它之所以存在，只因为 e 恰好在模 phi(n) 下可逆。看着这条链自己算出来：p 和 q 定下 n，n 与它的因子给出 phi(n)，e 必须与 phi(n) 互素，d 作为模逆元掉出来。弄断任何一环，页面不是崩溃而是把断口画给你看：phi = 60 时取 e = 3，gcd 是 3，于是 d 不存在，那一行变成洋红。然后是顿悟——上面这一切只压在一件事上：分解 n 很难。16 位数时你的浏览器用大约 100 毫秒、每秒 2.13 亿次试除就把它分掉，还原出与真值逐比特相同的 d，读出消息。每多两位数，代价涨十倍；2048 位与它的唯一区别就是数字的大小。已穷举验证：五把密钥、[0, n) 里的每一条消息都能往返，合计 22981 条。

tag.en: p,q to n to phi to e to d · the chain breaks visibly · factor it and d falls out · textbook RSA is deterministic
tag.zh: p,q → n → φ → e → d · 断口看得见 · 分解出来 d 就掉出来 · 教科书 RSA 是确定性的
